newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged after holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged after holiday.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade March SIR20 offer prices were unchanged on Wednesday after the Moslem Eid al-Fitr holidays, traders said.
"There is nothing happening today because of the extended holidays. We expect the market to return to normal next week," said one trader.
Traders said the market in Singapore also had not returned to normal after the Eid al-Fitr and Lunar New Year celebrations.
March SIR20 was quoted last week at 53.75-54.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and Surabaya and at 53.50-53.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang.
Offer prices were last quoted at 53.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Padang and at 53.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
During the Eid al-Fir celebrations, Indonesians usually return to their hometown, but they go back to work a week after the festivity ends.
